BiblicalUsage: Asarel is named once, in the families of Judah, as a son of Jehaleleel, with Ziph and Ziphah and Tiria and Asarel his brothers. The verse gives his father and his brothers and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in a family list with no story of its own still matters, because God counts the sons of Judah house by house, and no son is left out of the number.
